name: r6c_TextReset
notes: rewind both animation players of a text box unless a movie owns the screen; regargs: t=EAX

name: r6c_TextCount
notes: number of visible characters in an encoded string; hangs on NULL

name: r6c_TextLen
notes: byte length of an encoded string; hangs on NULL

name: r6c_TextIndex
notes: byte index of visible character n

name: r6c_TextNextPage
notes: move the cursor past the next page break (code 6) and recount the page

name: r6c_ChannelPlay
notes: restart a sound channel at a level and write its three registers

name: r6c_TextCharAt
notes: character code of visible character n (clamped); two-byte codes big-endian

name: r6c_MovieTask
notes: movie task: wait for loading then start playback and finish the task

name: r6c_MovieLoop
notes: movie render loop (never returns); calls 0x00077AA0 with EAX=frame

name: r6c_MovieStart
notes: register the three movie tasks and reset the movie state

name: r6c_SetFogColour
notes: set the fog colour from the table at 0x002DFF70

name: r6c_SpriteInitA
notes: initialise the first full-screen sprite; modern cl merges the four halfword stores into two dword stores

name: r6c_SpriteInitB
notes: initialise the second (black) full-screen sprite; modern cl merges the halfword stores into dword stores and two of the zero byte stores into one halfword store

name: r6c_DrawToBackBuffer
notes: point the GPU at the current back buffer (64-bit register value) and draw object a

name: r6c_BuildMatrix
notes: build a matrix from rotation angles a per-row scale and a position; regargs: m=ESI rot=EAX; 1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata

name: r6c_ObjCopyColour
notes: copy the object colour into one of two colour slots; 1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata

name: r6c_ObjUpdateAttach
notes: re-attach or detach each linked attachment of the object

name: r6c_ObjInit
notes: initialise a sprite object; float argument 250.0 pushed from .rdata by modern cl instead of as an immediate

name: r6c_ApplyVecs
notes: give every model part its table vector and light it; calls 0x00079910 with EDX=i EDI=&v

name: r6c_ObjRebuild
notes: rebuild the object matrix; calls 0x00079C40 with ESI=&o->m154 EAX=&o->v194 and 0x00079CB0 with ESI=o

name: r6c_ObjSetMatrix
notes: set the object matrix from b then refresh; calls 0x00079CB0 with ESI=o

name: r6c_ObjPlaceLight
notes: place the object light; float argument 224.0 pushed from .rdata by modern cl instead of as an immediate

name: r6c_ObjResetPose
notes: reset rotation and position and scale then rebuild; calls 0x00079C40 with ESI=&o->m154 EAX=&o->v194 and 0x00079CB0 with ESI=o; 1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata

name: r6c_ObjDrawAll
notes: draw the object's three layers and attachments and shadow

name: r6c_ObjPrepare
notes: light and tint and colour the object for drawing

name: r6c_CamAnimCopy
notes: copy a camera animation header and return its track set when the version is 0x65; original advances a pointer to +0x1C then by 4 and modern cl folds the offset into one +0x20

name: r6c_CamAnimInit
notes: initialise a camera animation (name; version 0x65; ten cleared tracks; one reference); loop strength reduction: original advances the +0x20 set pointer by 8 and modern cl folds the track offset into +0x28

name: r6c_AttachToPart
notes: attach b's first part to bone c of part n of a

name: r6c_AttachToHand
notes: attach b's first part to bone 9 of the current character; -1 for no node

name: r6c_NodeRelease
notes: release a part chain resource and clear every active flag; regargs: p=EAX

name: r6c_ListAddUnique
notes: add an item to a part list unless already a member; regargs: l=ESI it=EDX

name: r6c_ListRemove
notes: remove an item from a part list; regargs: l=EDI it=ESI

name: r6c_KeyNew
notes: allocate a 0x20-byte key block holding v; -2 when out of memory

name: r6c_TreeFreeAll
notes: free a node and its children and following siblings

name: r6c_TreeInsertAfter
notes: insert a sibling chain after a node

name: r6c_TreeRelease
notes: drop one reference from each sibling and release nodes that reach zero; calls 0x0007E6C0 with EAX=n->parts

name: r6c_PartsAddItems
notes: add each node item to the matching part list; calls 0x0007EC40 with ESI=list EDX=item

name: r6c_PartsRemoveItems
notes: remove each node item from the matching part list; calls 0x0007EC90 with EDI=list ESI=item

name: r6c_KeyNewFrom
notes: allocate a key block and fill +0x1C from decoded key info

name: r6c_TreeAddChild
notes: append a sibling chain to a parent's children

name: r6c_TreeFree
notes: free a whole subtree with its record chains

name: r6c_TreeUnref
notes: drop one reference and release the node at zero; calls 0x0007E6C0 with EAX=n->parts

name: r6c_TreeCreate
notes: create a 0x60-byte tree node for (a b c); calls 0x0007E6C0 with EAX=n->parts

name: r6c_ChildClearRec
notes: clear record i of the child entity (types 2 and 10) of an entity of type 1 or 9

name: r6c_PickNearest
notes: pick the nearest hit with one of two search methods; calls 0x00080A60 with ECX=c (a and b on the stack) and 0x000809C0 with EBX=a ECX=c (b on the stack)

name: r6c_BoxNew
notes: allocate an empty bounding box record; float constants stored as immediates by modern cl instead of loads from .rdata (same values)

name: r6c_BoxExtend
notes: grow a bounding box to include lo..hi

name: r6c_BTreeRemove
notes: remove an item from the item chain of any node of a binary tree; 1 when found

name: r6c_CollectHits
notes: collect the hits of src and give them to owner; 1 when there were any

name: r6c_LinkAppend
notes: fill a link record and append it to the owner chain

name: r6c_CollectBetween
notes: gather the entries under root between two points into a zero-terminated array

name: r6c_BoxBehind
notes: 1 when the box test vector has no positive component (or in free mode)

name: r6c_AngleAdd
notes: a + b wrapped into -pi..pi (float result in st0)

name: r6c_RotateVec
notes: rotate a vector by x then y then z angles

name: r6c_Res3Free
notes: free a resource record and its parts; returns the chain error

name: r6c_E28Add
notes: create a list member for resource a and append it; 1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata

name: r6c_MdlListNew
notes: allocate a model part list of n parts with cleared headers

name: r6c_MdlListChain
notes: run every model part through 0x001B7520 and 0x001B72C0 threading x through

name: r6c_TimersTick
notes: count down every positive timer and clamp negatives; loop strength reduction: original advances a pointer to the +4 time field and reads the object at -4

name: r6c_EvFirstA
notes: first entry of an event group whose flag is set (bytes to *a *b); regargs: g=EDI; original keeps a pointer to the +0x20 entries and reads +4 while modern cl folds it to +0x24

name: r6c_EvNextA
notes: next entry of an event group whose flag is set (bytes to *a *b); regargs: g=EDI; modern cl reads the first flag at +0x24 from the group instead of +4 from the entry pointer

name: r6c_EvFirstB
notes: first entry of an event group whose flag is set or NULL; regargs: g=EDI; original keeps a pointer to the +0x20 entries and reads +4 while modern cl folds it to +0x24

name: r6c_EvNextB
notes: next entry of an event group whose flag is set or NULL; regargs: g=EDI; modern cl reads the first flag at +0x24 from the group instead of +4 from the entry pointer

name: r6c_EvStartForEntry
notes: start the first event group for the current entry that has a set flag

name: r6c_EvStartGlobal
notes: start the first global (key 0xFF) event group with a set flag; 1 when it is not done

name: r6c_ItemSlotsInit
notes: bind the item set and build its slot array; loop strength reduction: the slot pointer is biased by +8 in the original and by +0x10 in modern cl so the field offsets differ

name: r6c_StreamPlayWait
notes: start the current stream and wait until it has played out

name: r6c_StreamSwitchWait
notes: stop the current stream then load and settle the next one

name: r6c_StreamReleaseStep
notes: step the stream release job (0 finished; 1 busy)

name: r6c_CamMarkersPlace
notes: place every event camera marker at its position and yaw; 1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata

name: r6c_EvJump
notes: run event jump handler i (table 0x002E03BC) when the event camera is on

name: r6c_CamGet
notes: current event camera position and direction and id; 1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata

name: r6c_CamReset
notes: reset the event camera and run its six init hooks; 1.0f stored as an immediate by modern cl instead of a load from .rdata

name: r6c_CamTick
notes: run the event camera state handler then its six tick hooks

name: r6c_CamFollowPlayer
notes: aim the event camera at the player; original keeps a pointer to the +0x300 body block across the call and modern cl folds +0x300+0x74 into one offset

name: r6c_EvSceneBegin
notes: begin an event scene and pick the camera mode

name: r6c_EvJumpStep
notes: step an event jump (0 finished; 1 running)

name: r6c_EvSceneReset
notes: reset the event scene state and point the camera at the player

name: r6c_EvRunJobA
notes: run the group's first job (0x000856F0) in the background then switch to mode 6

name: r6c_EvRunJobB
notes: run the group's second job (0x00085820) in the background then switch to mode 7

name: r6c_EvRunJobC
notes: run the group's third job (0x00085930) in the background then switch to mode 10

name: r6c_EvSpawnStep
notes: spawn more of the group's enemies while there is room; mode 12 when none are active

name: r6c_ScnClearAll
notes: clear the scene step states and the nine scene records at 0x002E0690

name: r6c_ScnEnterStep
notes: step a scene's enter handler (direct or as a background job); regargs: s=ESI

name: r6c_ScnLeaveStep
notes: step a scene's leave handler (direct or as a background job); regargs: s=ESI

name: r6c_ScnUpdate11
notes: scene update: lock the player and play effect 11 until the finish flag then unlock

name: r6c_ScnUpdate12
notes: scene update: lock the player and play effect 12 until the finish flag then unlock

name: r6c_EvStopEffects
notes: stop effect channel 2 and wait for stream 15 to finish

name: r6c_ScnUpdatePlay12
notes: scene update: play effect 12 once and finish at state 20

name: r6c_EvTimerTick
notes: advance the event timer and reset the event scene when it runs out
